title: The Relic Forger
text: In the Court's back alleys, a little man in a leather apron sells saints' relics he carved himself: fingerbones from pig bone, a holy eye from glass. His work is very good. Some of it is in the Court's own reliquaries.

options.label: Buy one of his saints; a good forgery serves as well as the real thing.

outcomes.text: It will fool almost anyone, and almost anyone is enough.

options.label: Expose him to the Court and let the faithful judge him.

outcomes.text: The Court thanks you. He does not, nor do the friends who bought from him.

options.label: The shrewdest blackmails him for whatever true relics he keeps hidden.

outcomes.text: He gives up a real relic from his private collection. He hates you now.
